ns2:course.label: Environmental Engineering Lab
ns2:course.description: (CEE 335) Combination of lecture and laboratory designed to provide exposure to the use of traditional analysis tools and techniques in analysis, control, and design of natural and engineered environmental systems including air, water, wastewater, solid and hazardous waste, and ecological systems. 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: CEE 437 or CEE 446.
